archetypes.name: sidecar-contract
archetypes.rationale: The launcher's sidecar/stdout/exit-code protocol (inner-sentinel, preflight bundle, LAUNCHER_EXIT on stdout, codex_launcher_promote_inner_done) is the most complex contract in the plan and is not covered by the static panel's broad structural review.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan introduces launch-codex-exec.sh wrapping run-external-agent.sh with a specific sidecar/stdout/exit-code protocol: .meta, .done, .diag, LAUNCHER_EXIT on stdout, inner-sentinel (.inner.done during retry, single codex_launcher_promote_inner_done after final attempt), and a preflight failure bundle (truncate output, .diag STATUS=FAILED, stub .meta CMD_JSON=[], .done, emit_kv LAUNCHER_EXIT, exit 0). Verify each claimed sidecar field name, stdout key, and exit-code value against the actual contracts in scripts/run-external-agent.sh, scripts/collect-agent-results.sh, and scripts/lib-external-launcher-common.sh (or lib-codex-launcher-common.sh). Confirm the plan's preflight failure bundle exactly mirrors the launch-review.sh:444-463 pattern it cites, and that the inner-sentinel promotion design is consistent with how collect-agent-results.sh polls for .done. Flag any field name, exit-code value, or protocol step that the plan describes differently from the live code in those files. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: lint-scope
archetypes.rationale: The linter's allowlist, env-assignment-prefix stripping, and no-file-scope-exemption rules are precise enough that gaps or false positives against real repo patterns are a concrete plan defect the generic correctness reviewer does not specifically hunt.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan adds lint-codex-exec-auth.sh with rules: shell scope (scripts/*.sh, skills/*/scripts/*.sh) excluding test-*.sh and larch-logs/; markdown fence scope (skills/**/*.md, .claude/skills/**/*.md, .claude/rules/*.md); basename allowlist of six launchers; per-line pragma only with no file-scope exemption; env-assignment-prefix stripping before command-word matching. Search the repo for existing codex exec call sites outside the six allowlisted launchers and check whether any are absent from the plan's scope-files list or updated-files list, since those would be violations the plan leaves unaddressed. Verify that the env-assignment-stripping rule handles multi-var prefix patterns (e.g. FOO=x CODEX_HOME=y codex exec) that appear in the actual codebase, and that the markdown fence scope covers all four updated fence files (research-phase.md, validation-phase.md, voting-protocol.md, dialectic-protocol.md) with no additional uncovered codex exec fences elsewhere. Flag any pattern the linter would miss or any allowlisted path the plan fails to justify as auth-wired. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: doc-parity
archetypes.rationale: Seven documentation and contract surfaces must all name the same expanded covered-path list; mismatches between them are operator-visible plan defects the static panel does not specifically hunt.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan updates seven documentation surfaces (docs/external-reviewers.md, skills/shared/external-reviewers.md, docs/configuration-and-permissions.md, SECURITY.md, .claude/rules/external-tool-launcher-parity.md, launch-codex-exec.md, lint-codex-exec-auth.md) plus two existing .md contracts (lint-fix-loop.md, run-negotiation-round.md), all of which must consistently name the same expanded covered-path list. Verify that each update description mentions all six swept surfaces (research lanes, validation lane, voter/judge fences, lint-fix-loop, run-negotiation-round, launch-codex-exec) without omission, and that no surface is routed to the wrong file (the plan restricts negotiation exit-code prose to skills/shared/external-reviewers.md:114 only, not docs/external-reviewers.md). Check that the sibling .md contracts for new scripts (launch-codex-exec.md, lint-codex-exec-auth.md) explicitly describe every contract element the .sh plan specifies: validate_meta_scalar_path gate, inner-sentinel retry, preflight failure bundle, --add-dir default, env-assignment-prefix skip, and pragma grammar. Flag any gap where a contract element appears in the script plan but is absent from its sibling .md description. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
